# 向量和矩阵

## 向量及其线性组合

```{python}
#| output: asis

from sympy import Matrix
from books.assets.reading_lab_display import display

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# 起点和终点
start = (-1, 2)
end = (4, 2)

fig, ax = plt.subplots()

# 画箭头：从 start 指向 end
ax.quiver(
    start[0],
    start[1],
    end[0] - start[0],
    end[1] - start[1],
    angles="xy",
    scale_units="xy",
    scale=1,
)

# 标记两个点
ax.scatter(*start)
ax.scatter(*end)

# 标注
ax.text(start[0], start[1], " (-1,2)")
ax.text(end[0], end[1], " (4,2)")

# 设置坐标范围
ax.set_xlim(-3, 6)
ax.set_ylim(0, 4)

# 显示网格和坐标轴
ax.grid(True)
ax.axhline(0)
ax.axvline(0)

plt.gca().set_aspect("equal")
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| output: asis

from sympy import Matrix
from books.assets.reading_lab_display import display

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# 向量
v = (4, 2)
w = (-1, 2)

fig, ax = plt.subplots()

# 画向量：都从原点出发
ax.quiver(0, 0, v[0], v[1], angles="xy", scale_units="xy", scale=1)
ax.quiver(0, 0, w[0], w[1], angles="xy", scale_units="xy", scale=1)

# 标出终点
ax.scatter([v[0], w[0]], [v[1], w[1]])

# 标注
ax.text(v[0], v[1], "  v=(4,2)")
ax.text(w[0], w[1], "  w=(-1,2)")
ax.text(0, 0, " O")

# 坐标轴
ax.axhline(0)
ax.axvline(0)
ax.grid(True)

# 显示范围
ax.set_xlim(-3, 6)
ax.set_ylim(-1, 4)

# 保证 x、y 刻度比例一致
ax.set_aspect("equal")

plt.show()
```
```{python}
#| output: asis

from sympy import Matrix
from books.assets.reading_lab_display import display

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3))

# 跷跷板
ax.plot([-3, 4], [0, 0], linewidth=4)

# 支点（三角形）
ax.scatter(0, -0.3, marker="^", s=300)

# 左边重量
ax.scatter(-1, 0.15, s=500)
ax.text(-1, 0.35, "weight = 4", ha="center")

# 右边重量
ax.scatter(2, 0.15, s=300)
ax.text(2, 0.35, "weight = 2", ha="center")

# 标出距离
ax.text(-1, -0.25, "x=-1", ha="center")
ax.text(2, -0.25, "x=2", ha="center")
ax.text(0, -0.5, "pivot", ha="center")

# 力方向箭头
ax.arrow(-1, 1, 0, -0.7, head_width=0.15, length_includes_head=True)

ax.arrow(2, 0.8, 0, -0.5, head_width=0.15, length_includes_head=True)

# 坐标范围
ax.set_xlim(-3, 4)
ax.set_ylim(-1, 2)

ax.axhline(0)
ax.axvline(0)

ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.axis("off")

plt.show()
```
